messages:
maria: Quick update — kicked off stratified bring-up of v2-int4 (mix: short-answer FAQ + long-doc retrieval) to 7% traffic at 09:05. Initial smoke was fine but after ~18.5k requests we see slice-level drift on two slices.
sam: Which slices are noisy?
maria: FAQ short-answer precision down ~2.1%; long-doc retrieval MRR down ~2.9%. p95 latency increased ~52ms on our dedicated pool.
jordan: That's borderline. What's our automatic fallback trigger set to now?
maria: Proposal: blended quality + latency gate to avoid flipping on transient noise. Draft: trigger fallback when (MRR_delta <= -2.5% over 25m AND p_value <= 0.05 with min_samples) OR (p95_latency_increase >= 50ms sustained for 10m).
anya: I'd keep p_value at 0.05 but require a min_samples floor. If we make p_value 0.01 we'll miss real regressions.
sam: Add promotion hysteresis — avoid immediate re-promote. Suggest 3 consecutive passing windows to auto-promote back.
jordan: Also tier cohort thresholds: internal QA can tolerate more degradation; production search stricter.
maria: Draft rollout config (pushed to staging as JSON blob in console):
```json
{
  "name": "v2-int4-stratified-onboard",
  "traffic_split": "7%",
  "slices": ["faq-short", "longdoc-search", "sys-text"],
  "fallback_rules": [
    {"type": "quality", "metric": "mrr", "window_mins": 25, "threshold_pct": -2.5, "p_value": 0.05, "min_samples": 6000},
    {"type": "latency", "metric": "p95_ms", "window_mins": 10, "threshold_ms": 50}
  ],
  "promotion_hysteresis": {"consecutive_windows": 3},
  "cohort_overrides": {"internal": {"threshold_pct": -4.0}, "search": {"threshold_pct": -0.8}}
}
```
sam: We also saw a couple 5xx spikes earlier on one host. Can that cause the MRR drop?
maria: Logs point to a TF32 fallback on node-az3-qp2 that caused transient 5xxs; ops cordoned that host. Not systemic. Adding host-level circuit-breaker: if host_error_rate > 1.5% for 12m, route traffic off host.
jordan: For the quality gate, are we using bootstrap CI or parametric tests? Bootstrapping handles skew and long-tailed MRRs better.
maria: Using bootstrap per-slice+cohort. The rollout engine returns delta, bootstrap CI, and a p-value. We use that p-value for the rule.
anya: Surface in Console: per-slice watchlist + automated Slack alert when any fallback rule trips. Alert payload should include slice, cohort, sample_count, delta_pct, p_value, p95_delta_ms, deploy_tag.
maria: Agreed. deploy-bot: rollouts: started v2-int4 7% to cohorts [faq-short,longdoc-search] by maria at 2024-05-24T09:05:01Z.
sam: Pre-widen checklist: (1) run 60m extended smoke on search cohort, (2) run 120k synthetic long-doc retrieval queries, (3) ensure telemetry retention for 72h for these metrics.
maria: We will hold widening until we observe 2x 25m windows with p_value > 0.05 and delta within +/-0.5% on production slices. If a slice trips quality AND latency rule, engine will auto-fallback to the previous pinned model and notify #eng-ml and oncall.
jordan: Edge case — quantized models sometimes change prefix-cache behavior and first-token distribution for very short prompts. Add a first-token distribution sanity check to offline evals (KL on top-1 token).
anya: I'll add that to the onboarding checklist + eval harness. Proposed smoke KL threshold: 0.10 on first-token across 10k sample queries.
sam: Who owns the rollout-watchlist runbook?
maria: I'll draft the runbook today and own changes this week; will ask for reviews. If we get noisy false positives we'll consider increasing min_samples or smoothing windows. :spiral_notepad:
deploy-bot: alert: node-az3-qp2 cordoned by ops at 2024-05-24T09:18:44Z due to kernel fallback.
maria: Thanks ops — please uncordon after kernel fix. We'll keep the promotion paused and monitor overnight.
anya: LGTM, added bootstrap test snippets to docs and the token-prefix test to the eval harness.
sam: Thanks all. Reconvene 09:30 tomorrow to decide on widen.
maria: Action items: anya - add tests + deck; jordan - run 120k synthetic; sam - extend smoke; i'll push final config to staging and link console panels.
